enunciado: Improve bubble sort so it stops when a pass makes no swap. Sort {1, 2, 3, 5, 4, 6, 7, 8} and {8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1} and show how many passes and comparisons each case needed.
objetivos: Use a flag to detect that the array is already sorted
Compare the best and the worst case
pistas: Set swapped = false at the start of each pass.
If it is still false at the end of the pass, it is sorted.
A nearly sorted array finishes in very few passes.
